item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
A Heat Advisory through Sunday evening and a slate of local government meetings on August 11 are the most immediate matters for Benton County residents.
Heat Advisory in effect until Sunday evening. A Heat Advisory issued by the National Weather Service runs until 8:00 PM CDT Sunday, with heat index values up to 108 expected. Residents are advised to take precautions against heat-related illness.
On the Bentonville City Council agenda: Approve a Planned Unit Development for 1002 SE 3rd Street. The council would approve a PUD that allows the specified parcels to be developed under modified rules, affecting how the site at 1002 SE 3rd Street can be used.
On the Bentonville Finance Committee agenda: Council to accept a grant for adaptive traffic signal evaluation.. The city would receive a $700,000 grant to evaluate AI-based traffic signal technologies, requiring a budget adjustment to recognize and appropriate the grant funds.
On the Bentonville City Council agenda: Vacate a Right of Way and establish a Drainage Easement. The council would approve vacating a right of way and establish a drainage easement at Lot 13, Block 11 and 14 of Gilmore's Addition, affecting how that strip of land can be used and allowing for drainage work.
Benton County considers One-Cent sales tax. Benton County officials are discussing a proposed one-cent sales tax during recent council and intergovernmental meetings.
Taziki’s opens in Rogers. Taziki’s Mediterranean Café opened a location in Rogers at 1771 W. Pleasant Grove Road, with about $950,000 invested.
Simmons Foods promotes executives, creates CCO role. Simmons Foods promoted Scott Salmon to chief commercial officer and named Jacob Rogers as his successor.
Walton Family Foundation gives $599,139 to NWACC program. The Walton Family Foundation awarded a $599,139 grant to NorthWest Arkansas Community College to expand its LIFE program.
Bike Park Grand Opening and Hyper Jump Jam announced. OZ Trails announced the grand opening of its Northwest Arkansas bike park and a Hyper Jump Jam event.
